android.desc:
NeoArchive is the all-in-one file manager and media toolbox for Android. Browse, organize, clean, convert, and create with 50+ built-in tools for files, PDFs, video, audio, and images — all in a single lightweight app.

📁 SMART FILE MANAGER
• Full-featured file explorer: copy, move, rename, batch rename, delete, search & filter
• Media galleries: photos, videos, music and documents in one place
• Storage analyzer & cleaner: find large files, duplicates and free up space
• Archive library: zip / unzip, compress and password-protect archives
• Vault: lock and hide private files behind a password
• Recycle bin: restore files you accidentally deleted
• WhatsApp saver: browse and save WhatsApp images, videos & statuses
• Built-in viewers: PDF, DOCX, text and Markdown
• Multi-window tabs, customizable home screen & material themes (dark / light)

🎬 VIDEO TOOLS
• Video compressor — shrink size, keep quality
• Batch video compressor (PRO)
• Video converter — change format
• Video to GIF maker
• Audio extractor — pull sound out of any video
• Audio converter — MP3, WAV, OGG, AAC, M4A

🖼 PHOTO & IMAGE TOOLS
• Image compressor & batch image compressor (PRO)
• Image format converter
• Crop, rotate & flip, resize, apply filters
• Photo collage maker
• AI background remover (PRO)
• Blur faces for privacy (PRO)

📄 PDF TOOLS
• Merge PDF files
• Split PDF into pages or ranges
• Convert images to PDF
• Add page numbers to PDF

🌐 MEDIA DOWNLOADERS
• YouTube downloader
• TikTok downloader
• Spotify downloader
(Downloaded files are saved locally for private, offline use.)

🛠 PRODUCTIVITY & UTILITY
• QR code scanner & QR code generator (PRO)
• vCard QR maker (PRO)
• Unit converter: currency, length, weight, temperature & more (PRO)
• Text formatter / cleaner (PRO)
• Link extractor & URL shortener
• Markdown previewer & Open Graph link preview
• AI assistant to help you find the right tool

🎮 GAMES & RELAXATION
• Chess with AI opponent
• Memory Flip
• Infinity Tic-Tac-Toe
• Snake Rush

🔒 PRIVACY & SECURITY
• Process sensitive files locally on your device
• Vault & recoverable deletes keep your data safe
• Minimal permissions — no account required
• Most tools work fully offline

🎨 MAKE IT YOURS
• Dark, light and custom accent themes
• Reorderable home widgets & shortcuts
• Tablet-optimized, multi-window layout

🌍 15 LANGUAGES
English, Indonesian, Arabic, Bulgarian, German, Spanish, Persian (Farsi), French, Hindi

quotes.text:
I built an offline-first Android app to manage files, convert media, split PDFs, and more. Works without login, optimized for low-end phones.

Built using Flutter with native plugins for audio/video processing.

Not meant to be fancy — just solving the problem I had with juggling too many apps.

You can search NeoArchive on Play Store if curious. Feedback welcome!
